summary: Mobile-only frontend copy/label batch verification for signup, login and Settings logout. All 6 requested acceptance criteria pass end-to-end on the Expo web preview at 390x844: (1) /signup no standalone 'Wayly' wordmark, no 'Create account' header, no 'Join Wayly…' tagline — only 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY'; (2) Field labels are Title Case ('First Name', 'Last Name', 'Mobile Number'), 'First Name'/'Last Name'/'Email'/'Password' each render a clay 'Required' hint, 'Mobile Number' renders 'Optional'; (3) Password requirements list ('At least 8 characters', 'An uppercase and a lowercase letter', 'A number and a symbol', 'Not your name or email') is visible BEFORE typing; (4) Plan picker shows Solo '1 participant tracked · 1 caregiver seat' and Family '2 participants · Up to 3 caregiver seats' — no '5 caregiver seats', no 'two parents on one plan' string; radios toggle when tapping the plan card; (5) /login shows 'Welcome Back' + subtitle 'Sign in to your account' (no 'Wayly' in subtitle) and no standalone 'Wayly' wordmark under the logo; (6) Settings logout button label is exactly 'Log Out' (testID settings-logout). Regression: cathy@example.com/testpass123 logs in and lands on the dashboard (viewing 'Mum', Family plan, ACTIVE).
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational, not a failure): the login screen renders the sign-up link as 'New to Wayly? Create an account'. The batch removed the 'Create account' HEADER on /signup as required, but the word 'Wayly' still appears in the /login footer link ('New to Wayly?') and in a few Settings copy strings (e.g. 'When Wayly flags…', 'What you have done with Wayly'). These were NOT called out in the acceptance criteria so are left as-is; flagging in case a broader wordmark sweep is planned.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (23/23 assertions across signup, login, plan toggle, login regression, settings logout)

test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (family plan, worked on preview)
